summary: Iteration 3 verified: RAGAS golden test-set successfully expanded from 8 to 45 questions. All acceptance criteria pass. (1) GET /api/testset returns 45 items with correct distribution (10/10/10/10 per seed doc + 5 OUT_OF_SCOPE) and no null/empty fields. (2) POST /api/evaluations/run scope=testset limit=45 completed on the backend in 167.66s, persisted with n_samples=45, aggregate faithfulness=0.8019, answer_relevancy=0.3903, context_precision=0.7748, and 135/135 numeric metric values across all 45 per_row entries. (3) Hallucination resistance is EXCELLENT: all 5 OUT_OF_SCOPE questions produced the exact refusal string 'I don’t have enough information in the provided documents to answer this.' with zero invented citations. (4) Frontend Eval Dashboard renders metric cards, per-row table, trend chart, and the historical n_samples=45 row shows up correctly.

minor.issue: Client-side receives Cloudflare 502 after ~60s because ingress gateway kills long-lived synchronous requests. Backend still completes (167s) and persists the run correctly to Mongo, but the UI's `runEval` mutation cannot receive the response for a 45-item run — the response never reaches the browser. Only visible workaround today is to reload the History table to see the completed run. Consider moving /api/evaluations/run to a background job with a poll/SSE progress endpoint, or streaming per-row results, so users triggering a full 45-item eval from the UI actually see it finish.

ui_bugs.issue: Scope option label is stale: shows 'Golden test-set (8 Q&A)' but test-set is now 45 items. Update to 'Golden test-set (45 Q&A)' or make it dynamic.
Default `limit` state is hard-coded to 8 (line 39). To eval the full new testset users must manually change it to 45. Consider defaulting to 45 (or to testset length) when scope='testset'.

integration_issues.issue: Even if user sets limit=45 and clicks Run, Cloudflare ingress will 502 at ~60s. UI never receives result. Backend run does persist and appears in Historical table after refresh, but the toast shows 'Eval failed'. See backend minor issue above.

action_items: Update EvalDashboard.jsx scope option label from 'Golden test-set (8 Q&A)' to '(45 Q&A)' (or dynamic based on /api/testset length).
Update EvalDashboard.jsx default limit from 8 to 45 (or auto-fill from testset length when scope='testset').

OPTIONAL: Make /api/evaluations/run async (background task + polling) so full-testset runs are usable from the UI — currently the 60s Cloudflare gateway kills the sync request even though the backend finishes in ~2–3 min.
OPTIONAL (from iter 2): Langfuse trace link href still lands on host root, not the specific trace — append /trace/<id>.
critical_code_review_comments: test_set.py is clean, well-structured, and includes explicit adversarial OUT_OF_SCOPE items — good hallucination-resistance coverage.

The /api/evaluations/run endpoint is synchronous and will 502 for any testset large enough to run >60s under the current ingress. This will limit scaling the golden set beyond ~15–20 items without an architectural change.

Old test in /app/backend/tests/test_rag_eval.py::TestTestset still asserts len(ts) == 8 — will now fail. Should be updated to 45 (I did not modify it since the current file is regression-owned; flagging for main agent).

One data point: for the question 'Where is Acme Corp's global headquarters located?' the RAGAS faithfulness score was 0.0 despite the model correctly refusing. This is a known RAGAS artifact (empty claim set from a refusal answer yields 0 faithfulness). Not a bug in the app, but worth noting when interpreting aggregate scores on a testset with adversarial items.
